name: @dsor-steps/mj-36-write-it-down-before-you-act
description: Step 36 of the DSoR baby steps, a learner build: write it down before you act. Before a command calls a bank, DSoR commits an intent record in dsor.intents, append-only, with the proposal, the operation, the fingerprint, the key, the connector, and who asked (DSOR-EXE-03a); if it cannot, the bank is never called (DSOR-EXE-03b). A note with no outcome, after a crash, is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: at start-up, on a replay, and when the proposal is read (DSOR-EXE-04b). Proved by killing a real process between the note and the result.
